webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Slack incoming webhook URL, from a channel's App settings page. Must start with https://.
webhookUrl.invalid: Enter a Slack webhook URL that starts with https:// and does not embed credentials

minSeverity.title: Minimum severity
minSeverity.description: Only notifications at or above this severity are forwarded.

config.edited: Slack webhook settings have been updated
config.notEdited: Failed to update Slack webhook settings

texts.aboutSlackSettings: Forward system notifications to a Slack channel as a coloured attachment, using a Slack incoming webhook. In Slack, create (or reuse) an app with an Incoming Webhook enabled for the target channel and copy its webhook URL.
